study_area: St. Augustine, FL; REGIONAL OSM drive network, 6000 m around (29.885,-81.315); bbox lat 29.8311..29.9383, lon -81.3771..-81.2654. EXPERIMENTAL / PROVISIONAL.
noaa_input: 2026 reprocessed NOAA SLOSH MOM HIGH tide category 1-5 crops
noaa_interpretation: potential planning-envelope inundation, NOT a storm forecast
closure_rule: At least one sample every ~20m has NOAA depth class >= 3 (lower bound 2ft)
bridge_rule: OSM bridge=yes edges exempt from water-depth closure; bridge approaches not exempt; NOT a structural safety assessment
routing: directed OSM driving graph, shortest path by road length (not ambulance travel time)
origins: every 18th node by sorted id (Engine rule); NOT population-weighted and NOT the same nodes as the 4 km graph
facilities: OSM amenity=hospital / emergency=yes elements in bbox (Overpass); emergency-department entrances NOT verified; snap distance reported in facilities.csv
limitations: No actual storm timeline, rainfall, bridge deck heights, wind effects, congestion, emergency speeds, population, or official road closures.
regional_note: Same closure rule as data/access; sampler validated against data/access/directed_edges.csv (see docs/MEDICAL_ACCESS.md).
